notes: The source URL and catalog text are for the Interdisciplinary Studies (Letters and Science) A.A. degree, not the Civil Engineering A.S. Degree. No section for Civil Engineering appears in the text, so no blocks, totals, outcomes or careers were recorded.

Several closed-list courses (CHEM 210, CHEM 220, MATH C2210, MATH C2220, MATH 253, MATH 270, MATH 275, PHYS 250, PHYS 260, PHYS 270) appear only in an Interdisciplinary Studies area-of-emphasis elective list ('Choose at least 9 units'), which does not describe the Civil Engineering requirements.

The outcomes printed on the page ('Apply scientific concepts and principles to explain physical processes in the world.'; 'Demonstrate effective communication through written and oral forms, and through other forms as appropriate.') belong to the Interdisciplinary Studies program and were not recorded for this award.
The text is cut off mid-list (at 'LIT. 251'). A reviewer should locate the correct Civil Engineering A.S. catalog page.
